staff.label: Staff feedback survey
staff.title: Executive Director / CEO Annual Review — Staff Feedback
staff.description: Your feedback is part of the ED/CEO's annual review and gives the Board a fuller picture of leadership from within the team — a perspective only you can offer. This survey is anonymous. Your name is not collected, responses are read together (not individually attributed), and individual answers are not shared with the ED/CEO. There are no right or wrong answers — honest, specific feedback is the most useful.

sections.label: Vision & Strategic Leadership
sections.description: How the ED/CEO communicates direction, makes decisions, and leads strategically.
sections.commentPrompt: One thing the ED/CEO could do to strengthen the organisation’s direction

questions.label: Communicates a clear and inspiring vision.
questions.subtext: I understand where we are heading and why

questions.label: Makes sound decisions in uncertain or complex situations.
Prioritises what matters most and adapts when things change.

sections.label: People Leadership & Culture
sections.description: How the ED/CEO leads the team, builds culture, and develops people.
sections.commentPrompt: One thing the ED/CEO does well as a people leader, and one area to develop

questions.label: Creates a positive, inclusive environment.
Recognises and values the contributions of team members.
Addresses issues fairly and models the organisation’s values.

sections.label: Communication & Transparency
sections.description: How the ED/CEO communicates with the team and maintains openness.
sections.commentPrompt: Anything about how the ED/CEO communicates you’d like to see change

questions.label: Shares important information in a timely, clear way.
Is approachable and listens genuinely.
Is transparent about decisions and changes, even difficult ones.

sections.label: Operational Effectiveness
sections.description: How the ED/CEO runs the organisation day-to-day.
sections.commentPrompt: What aspect of operational leadership works best, and what could improve

questions.label: Is organised and follows through on commitments.
Manages resources and budget responsibly.
Builds systems and processes that help the team work well.

sections.label: Innovation & Adaptability
sections.description: How the ED/CEO encourages new thinking and moves initiatives forward.
sections.commentPrompt: A specific example of the ED/CEO showing innovation or adaptability

questions.label: Encourages creative and innovative thinking.
questions.subtext: Openness to new ideas and approaches

questions.label: Takes appropriate, calculated risks to move things forward.
Drives initiatives from idea through to implementation.

sections.label: Partnership & External Representation
sections.description: How the ED/CEO builds relationships and represents the organisation externally.
sections.commentPrompt: What you observe about how the ED/CEO approaches partnerships

questions.label: Builds trust with external partners and stakeholders.
Represents the organisation well externally.
Advances meaningful inclusion in engagement.

overallPrompts.greatestStrength: What does the ED/CEO do best? Their greatest strength as a leader
overallPrompts.importantChange: The single most important thing they could do differently to be more effective
overallPrompts.additionalComments: Anything else you'd like the Board Chair to know

staff.commentPlaceholder: A specific example or observation is especially helpful.
staff.closingTitle: Thank you for taking the time
staff.closingDescription: Your feedback is valued and used constructively to support the ED/CEO's development and the Board's assessment.
staff.footerNotice: Confidential feedback instrument · Provided through Olea Connects · Not for distribution without an active membership.

partner.label: Partner and stakeholder feedback survey
partner.title: Executive Director / CEO Annual Review — External Feedback
partner.description: Your organisation's work depends on trusted relationships. As someone who has engaged with the organisation and its ED/CEO, your view on that relationship and their leadership helps the Board support strong, accountable leadership. This survey is anonymous — your name and organisation are not collected unless you choose to share them, and responses are reviewed by the Board Chair only. Written comments are optional but especially valuable; a specific example goes a long way.

sections.label: Relationship Quality & Trust
sections.description: The quality of the relationship you have experienced with the ED/CEO and the organisation.
sections.commentPrompt: What has the ED/CEO done well in building or sustaining the relationship — and what could improve?

questions.label: Has built a genuine, productive relationship with my organisation.
questions.subtext: Quality and authenticity of the partnership

questions.label: Is reliable and follows through on commitments.
Communicates professionally and responsively.
Represents partner and community interests fairly.

sections.label: Strategic Presence & External Leadership
sections.description: How the ED/CEO represents the organisation externally and contributes to the wider ecosystem.
sections.commentPrompt: How has the ED/CEO’s leadership contributed to collaboration or progress in your sector or community?

questions.label: Clearly articulates the organisation’s purpose and value.
questions.subtext: Clarity of mission and vision externally

questions.label: Demonstrates credible understanding of the sector.
Is an effective convener who brings the right people together.
Contributes positively to the broader ecosystem.

sections.label: Inclusion & Community Engagement
sections.description: How the ED/CEO approaches inclusion, equity and engagement with the communities served.
sections.commentPrompt: How well is the organisation advancing inclusion and engagement — and what could be strengthened?

questions.label: Actively includes under-represented and underserved communities.
The organisation’s work reflects the needs of the communities it serves.
Creates genuine opportunities for community voice and participation.
My organisation or community is valued as a genuine partner.

sections.label: Impact & Endorsement
sections.description: The organisation’s outcomes and the ED/CEO’s role in driving them.
sections.commentPrompt: Can you describe a specific example where the ED/CEO’s leadership contributed to a meaningful outcome?

questions.label: Demonstrates a genuine commitment to innovation and improvement.
The organisation’s work generates meaningful, real-world outcomes.
I would recommend engaging with this organisation and its ED/CEO.

overallPrompts.greatestStrength: The ED/CEO's greatest strength, from your perspective
overallPrompts.importantChange: One thing you'd most like them to focus on next year
overallPrompts.additionalComments: Anything else you'd like the Board to know

partner.commentPlaceholder: A specific example is especially helpful.
partner.closingTitle: Thank you for your time and partnership
partner.closingDescription: Your feedback supports strong, accountable leadership. Please return by the deadline above.
partner.footerNotice: Confidential feedback instrument · Provided through Olea Connects · Not for distribution without an active membership.
